scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 29 km this is High Road to Taos, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

scenicChapters.title: Alisher Navoi Cinema Palace → Big Solar Furnace
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 54 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-alisher-navoi-cinema-palace-besh-.story: A 338 km round trip from Tashkent - roughly 5 h 50 in the saddle. It goes by way of Big Solar Furnace, The Chatkal State Biosphere Nature Reserve, Besh-Aral State Nature Reserve - main part and back through The Chatkal State Biosphere Nature Reserve. The highest point is about 2,700 m. It crosses from Uzbekistan into Kyrgyzstan - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
